title: Juno email - can send but cannot receive emails
creator: gtug
content:
I use Juno email and utilize Thunderbird to manage it. After being offline for 2 weeks, I turned on my desktop and logged into Thunderbird as usual. It did request to update and I allowed it (maybe that was my mistake?) and proceeded.

My account came up where I left it, the last unread messages were there, but I got this error when I tried to retrieve new messages: "An error occurred with the POP3 mail server. Mail server pop.juno.com responded: Service unavailable"

I've checked my last password and it was correct, the recommended POP (995)/SMTP Outgoing (465) servers/ports and used the "Test connection to server" links ... all to no avail. I read that sometimes the Firewall would get in the way so I manually added Thunderbird to the Windows Defender security firewall. No change. I restarted the computer, I turned the computer off then back on.

I've been working on this for a couple of hours and can't get anywhere. Would appreciate some assistance. Thanks in advance.

Running on a Windows based desktop HP Pavilion i3 10-100 CPU x64-based PC using Windows 11 Home version 10.0.26200 Build 26200
